# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_VIX_FILTER_TIGHTEN

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Requiring VIX >= 20 at entry for bearish BEARISH_REJECTION setups will filter out low-VIX choppy environments where the setup fails, preserving edge on high-VIX winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) while reducing losses on low-VIX loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07).

## Mechanism

Add a pre-entry filter that checks the real-time VIX value (from the same data feed used for other indicators) and only allows BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entries when VIX >= 20.0. All other entry conditions (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence) remain unchanged. Exit logic (chart stop, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop, time stop) is unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to min 3-contract floor.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest will use the autoresearch grinder's default in-sample window (approx 16 months of 5m SPY bars, ~69k bars). Selection is walk-forward split; overfit risk mitigated by requiring OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill validation on top 3 J days not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** worst day could be a high-VIX loser day where filter incorrectly blocks a winning entry; max drawdown scenario if filter causes missed winners during sustained high-VIX trends; blow-up scenario if filter triggers excessive whipsaws in ranging markets increasing transaction costs.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators must pass; walk-forward OOS must show positive edge_capture and Sharpe; real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show <±20% diff vs BS sim; concentration check must show top5_pct <= 200% (or similar).

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- hypothesis based on observed VIX regime sensitivity in prior research (see LESSONS-LEARNED L40, L44, L45) but lacks direct validation on J anchor days.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

Does not conflict with existing candidates 1-9; complements VIX-related filters like V14E_BEAR_ONLY_GATE and F8_BULL_VIX_GATE_REVAL by adding a VIX floor to bearish entries.
